text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen: 1,600m. The distance is 
right at the very edge of my limit. My 
opponent is Taiki, and to make matters 
worse, the turf is bad...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
An all-star lineup with a blue motif. But 
if I run among them, I know I'll prove 
what I'm truly made of!
